findings.title: Root cron job executes writable file
findings.evidence: Cron line in /etc/cron.d/sysstat: '59 23 * * * root command -v debian-sa1 > /dev/null && debian-sa1 60 2' references world-writable target /dev/null.
findings.exploitation_possibility: Writable script/binary executed by root cron can lead to direct root code execution.
findings.mitigation: Restrict file permissions, enforce root ownership, and validate cron targets.
